findings.title: Review Boltz 2026 security-driven swap shutdown
findings.summary:
## Signal

Boltz announced on 2026-08-03 that all swaps remain disabled until further notice after a multi-month increase in automated AI-assisted probing, several contained exploits, and internal security-scan findings. The operator stated that refund mechanisms and support remain available and that no user funds were at risk.

## First-party sources

- https://x.com/Boltzhq/status/2084311537502630319
- https://boltz.exchange/
- https://api.docs.boltz.exchange/claiming-swaps.html

## Current BIR disposition

`monitoring signal / needs evidence`, not canonical yet.
